# Posture tiers

Each posture tier maps to one preset: **workshop** is `presets/greenfield.yaml`, **secure** is `presets/security-focused.yaml`, **production** is `presets/production.yaml`.

The table on this page is generated from those presets. Run `python scripts/gen_posture_tiers.py` to produce it.
